item.description: The Paradeswar Temple in Dharamgarh in Kalahandi district of Odisha continues to draw large numbers of devotees, with its 52 kg mercury Shivling remaining the focal point of attraction. item.title: Several passengers sustain injuries as OSRTC bus overturns in Odisha's Malkangiri
item.description: At least eight passengers were seriously injured after a government bus met with an accident at the Salur bypass in Odisha’s Malkangiri district in the early hours of Sunday. According to reports, the accident occurred at around 3 am when the bus was travelling from MV-79 to Visakhapatnam. A total of 31 persons were on board, including 29 passengers, the driver and the bus staff.
